name: fitbit-air-tracker
description: Prayer-aware smart wake app powered by Google Fitbit Air sleep data

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.mobile: npm run build -w packages/core && npm start -w mobile
